resources.string: Luna
Setup link
The link made by luna-web add-device (https://host/#key=...). Connects the app to Luna with no typing. The server address and key below override the ones inside it.
Server address
Where Luna\'s token service is, for example https://luna.example.com. Leave empty to use the setup link or what the person entered.
Device key
This device\'s key for the token service. Leave empty to use the setup link or what the person entered.
What Luna calls the person
A first name. Leave empty to let the person choose.
What the person calls the assistant
Replaces the name Luna in notifications and on screen. Leave empty to let the person choose.
Ring for calls and reminders
Keeps a quiet connection open so Luna can speak first: a timer, a reminder, or something at home.
Listen for wake words
The microphone is always on while this is on (a notification is shown). The person still has to allow the microphone once, unless your policy grants that permission.
Wake words
Comma-separated ids from: ron, rulon, alexa, hey_jarvis, hey_mycroft, hey_rhasspy. Leave empty to let the person choose.
Wake word sensitivity
How easily the wake words start Luna. The person can still tune single words.
Say hi when Luna opens
A quick recorded greeting so the person knows Luna is listening.
Show the end button in the popup
Off: the popup over other apps has no end button, and closes when the person taps outside it.
Some settings are set by your organization and can\'t be changed here.
